title: Murderous
summary: MUR'DEROUS, adjective Guilty of murder; as the murderous king. 1. Consisting in murder; done with murder; bloody; cruel; as murderous rapine. 2. Bloody; sanguinary; committing murder; as murderous tyr

inlines.v: MUR'DEROUS, adjective Guilty of murder; as the murderous king. 1. Consisting in murder; done with murder; bloody; cruel; as murderous rapine. 2. Bloody; sanguinary; committing murder; as murderous tyranny. 3. Premeditating murder; as murderous intent or design.
